access_evidence: POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award/ returned HTTP 200 for three filter sets (PSC, NAICS, device keywords), 100 rows each; the official PSC filter tree (depth=3, 382,700 B) and the data dictionary (358,054 B) answered keylessly.
blockers: NO_ACTION_DATE: the spending_by_award field set does not return the award action date (requesting 'Action Date' yields null), so event_at is the period-of-performance start.
NO_PUBLICATION_DATE: no per-award publication timestamp is returned.

PSC_CONTAMINATION: 6515 mixes instruments with COVID-19 tests and vaccines; 6550 is reagents/test kits; 6540 is OPHTHALMIC instruments and 6545 is REPLENISHABLE FIELD MEDICAL SETS (the brief's assumption for both was wrong).
NO_DEVICE_MANUFACTURER: the award text names the supplier, never the OEM.
PAGE1_ONLY: 100 rows per query — a sample of the largest awards, not a census.
historical_depth: awards from FY2008 (API message: 'earliest date of 2007-10-01')
licence_note: No explicit reuse-licence sentence was found on the pages fetched (https://www.usaspending.gov/about returned a 3,003 B JS shell with no licence statement). Recorded as publicly readable without an explicit reuse licence rather than assumed permissive; the underlying records are the awarding agencies' own public contract data.
machine_interface: REST JSON; award search is POST-only (GET returns HTTP 405)
name: USAspending.gov — federal award search API v2
notes: device_relation_status is CANDIDATE even when the text names a device class: no OEM is identified.
operator: US Department of the Treasury (Bureau of the Fiscal Service)
rate_policy: No key, no documented quota; 3 POSTs used.
unlock_route: No blocker for access. For a census instead of a sample, page through with generated_internal_id / last_record_sort_value, or use the bulk_download endpoints listed at https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/endpoints.
what_is_new: 245 unique federal contract awards naming a recipient, with the recipient pinned by SAM UEI (245/245), award amount, period of performance, awarding agency, NAICS, verified PSC label, and a device-naming analysis (70 awards name a device class, 11 carry a model-like token).
